cases.requirement: 初回loadとcleanup: 登録を解除し、元のhost処理を維持する
cases.detail: load+cleanup+reload on opencode 2.0.7; plugin state active

cases.requirement: 履歴readback: 一時guidanceがcanonical user意思へ変わらない
cases.detail: temporary system guidance reached the model call and was absent from session readback

cases.requirement: 先行pluginがdraftを書換え: 観測draftを原文と偽らない
cases.detail: hook order honoured config order: warden recorded the rewritten draft (observed_prompt_draft)

cases.requirement: permissionとexecute.before順序: 認可と実行対象の相違を検出する
cases.detail: on the tested host, execute.before ran before permission.evaluate; before is a request observation, not an authorization

cases.requirement: 成功した実toolとWarden障害: tool成功をWardenエラーへ変えない
cases.detail: warden recording failed without changing the successful tool result; durability degraded was reported

cases.requirement: before以降にinputが変更: requested/effectiveを混同しない
cases.detail: a later hook changed the effective input; the requested and executed commands differed

cases.requirement: 元のaskとWarden: askをallowへ変えない
cases.detail: ask stayed a pending request while Warden abstained; execution required an explicit user reply

cases.requirement: config denyの最終優先順位: Wardenによる弱化なし、他pluginとの最終動作を確認
cases.detail: configured deny skipped the permission hook and produced no side effect; after hook absent (a missing after must stay outcome_unknown)

cases.requirement: typed RPC register/call: read-only status method

cases.detail: plugin storage counter persisted across a location reload

cases.requirement: review RPC is rejected when live Jev is disabled
cases.detail: live Jev stays off by default; the review RPC is rejected before any transport call

cases.requirement: explicit review RPC runs live Jev, records answers, and enforces budget
cases.detail: live review through the plugin: sufficiency 0.04 -> 0.88, claim 0.02 -> 0.96; credential-shaped state rejected locally; budget enforced at 2

cases.requirement: active bundle pin survives rollback; revocation stops guidance
cases.detail: active candidate-specific-definition-guidance-v1 pinned to A (guidance on); rollback pinned B to baseline and kept A; revocation stopped guidance for A

cases.requirement: fault injection: timeout, 5xx, 429, invalid answer, budget exhaustion
cases.detail: timeout, 500, 429 and an out-of-range answer stayed unavailable/invalid_response without normalisation; the invalid value was kept raw for audit; the budget stopped the fifth call locally

cases.requirement: an unwritable outbox degrades durability without changing tool results
cases.detail: writing the outbox to an unwritable path degraded durability while the tool result stayed unchanged

cases.requirement: TUI plugin load and command surface
cases.detail: TUI process did not import the ./tui entry (moduleImported=false, setup=false, listedInPanel=true); on opencode 2.0.7 the CLI-side loader reports "Keymap.Provider is missing" and the interactive TUI does not load V2 ./tui entries

cases.requirement: mutation detection separates regression from setup failure
cases.detail: isolated copy: baseline passed, wrong implementation detected at the assertion, broken setup classified as setup_error, tolerated change passed, main tree unchanged

notes: All model calls were served by a local OpenAI-compatible mock on 127.0.0.1.
No Jev/Lab/network call was made by this run.
